welcomeBody: Thanks for joining LocalCooks. Your account is ready.
passwordResetBody: Use the link below to reset your password. It expires soon.
verifyEmailBody: Confirm your email address to finish setting up your account.
tourVisitPendingBody: The scheduled tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} has ended. Record whether the kitchen tour took place, the visitor did not attend, or the tour was disrupted. Missing arrival or departure taps do not establish absence.
tourVisitReviewBody: The saved kitchen tour records for {visitor} at {kitchen} need Local Cooks review. Original evidence is preserved. No time or result has been inferred.
tourVisitCorrectedBody: A detail of the kitchen tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} was corrected. Open the tour to read the explanation. The appointment and tour result are unchanged.
tourVisitRepairedBody: Local Cooks reviewed the kitchen tour details for {visitor} at {kitchen}. Open the tour to read the explanation. The tour result is unchanged.
tourVisitArrivedBody: Arrival for {visitor} at {kitchen} was recorded. Open the tour to see the saved time.
tourVisitLeftBody: Departure for {visitor} at {kitchen} was recorded. Open the tour to see the saved time.
tourFeedbackRequestedTitle: How did your kitchen tour go?
tourFeedbackRequestedBody: Did your kitchen tour at {kitchen} happen? Tell us how it went and what we could do better.
tourFeedbackManagerRequestedTitle: How did the tour with {visitor} go?
tourFeedbackManagerRequestedBody: Did {visitor}’s tour of {kitchen} take place? Tell us how the visit went and what we could improve.
tourFeedbackMissingBody: At least one tour response is still missing. Follow up with the parties, review the available information and close the tour with an explained result. Missing feedback does not establish visitor absence.
tourFeedbackConflictBody: The tour responses disagree about whether the kitchen tour happened. Review the private responses and record an explained result.
tourFeedbackReadyBody: Both parties have submitted feedback. Review their private responses and record the tour result. Responses do not automatically complete or approve anything.
tourVisitUnknownBody: Local Cooks couldn’t confirm whether the kitchen tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} happened. We’ve closed this tour request. Open the tour to read the explanation or contact Support for help.
tourVisitCompletedBody: Local Cooks has confirmed that the kitchen tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} took place. Open the tour for the shared notes and next steps. Contact Support if something looks wrong.
tourCompletionApplyBody: Request to apply when you’re ready. You can review your answers before sending.
tourCompletionExistingBody: You already have an application or kitchen access. Open the next step to continue or review your current progress.
tourVisitAbsentTitle: The chef didn’t attend the kitchen tour
tourVisitAbsentBody: Local Cooks was told that {visitor} didn’t attend the kitchen tour at {kitchen}. Open the tour for the explanation. Contact Support if something looks wrong.
tourVisitDisruptedTitle: The kitchen tour couldn’t go ahead
tourVisitDisruptedBody: The kitchen tour for {visitor} at {kitchen} couldn’t go ahead. Open the tour for the reason and shared notes, or contact Support for help.
tourVisitHistoricalBody: There is a result recorded for the past tour for {visitor} at {kitchen}, but the original kitchen tour information is incomplete. Open the tour or contact Support for help reviewing it.
tourFeedbackPrivacy: Only you and Local Cooks can see your feedback.
tourFeedbackNextStep: Ready to book this kitchen? Request to apply when you’re ready.
sessionEndingHeading: Your booked time is almost up
sessionEndingBody: Your booked time at {kitchen} ends at {time} ({zone}). When you are finished, open your visit and start check-out. Need more time? Message the kitchen from your visit page.
sessionEndingNote: Leaving early does not refund unused booked time. If something is wrong, use Report a problem or Get help on your visit page.
arrivalModeStaffed: When you arrive, ask kitchen staff for your 6-digit check-in code and enter it in Local Cooks. It's for checking in only; it doesn't open the door.
arrivalModeSelf: Self check-in is on for this visit. Follow the kitchen's instructions to get in, then confirm arrival in Local Cooks. No check-in code needed.
arrivalEachDay: Each day of this booking has its own check-in and code.
arrivalModeMixed: Arrival method varies by visit. Open each visit for details.
arrivalModeLegacy: Follow the arrival instructions and confirm arrival in Local Cooks when you're there.
arrivalActionStaffed: Ask kitchen staff for your check-in code, then enter it in Local Cooks to check in.
arrivalActionSelf: Follow the kitchen instructions to get in, then confirm arrival in Local Cooks. No check-in code needed.
arrivalActionMixed: Arrival method varies by visit. Open each visit for details.
arrivalActionLegacy: Follow the arrival instructions and confirm arrival in Local Cooks.
instructionsReleaseOverview: Full arrival and departure instructions arrive {releaseAt}, {hours} hours before your visit.
instructionsReleased: Your full arrival and departure instructions are now available below.
visitPreparationSubject: Get ready for your kitchen visit · {kitchen}
visitArrivalInstructionsLink: Arrival instructions: see your preparation email or open your visit.
managerArrivalStaffed: Have the check-in code ready and share it with {chef} in person. It's not a door code.
managerArrivalSelf: Self check-in is on. Make sure {chef} can get in and reach you.
managerArrivalLegacy: Make sure {chef} can get in and reach you.
arrivalChangedStaffedSubject: You'll meet kitchen staff for this visit · {kitchen}
arrivalReissuedBody: Meet kitchen staff as planned. If they already gave you a check-in code, ask for the current one before confirming arrival.
arrivalTimeUnchanged: Your booked time has not changed.
bookingRefundDestination: To your original card; banks usually take 5–10 business days.
bookingDeadlineOnPage: the response deadline shown on your request
bookingRequestSentBody: {kitchen} has until {deadline} to respond. Your card is on hold and you’re only charged if they accept.
bookingNewRequestBody: Respond by {deadline}. If you don’t, the request expires and the customer’s hold is released.
bookingManagerStaffedBody: Plan who will welcome {chef}. The check-in code is on the booking page; share it with the customer in person. It's for Local Cooks and doesn't open the door.
bookingManagerSelfBody: Self check-in is on for {chef}. Make sure the customer can get in and reach you.
bookingAdminConfirmedBody: Payment is recorded and the booking is confirmed. Open the booking to review the current itinerary.
bookingReleaseOnPage: Open your booking for the instruction release time.
bookingCancellationPolicy: Cancellation follows your saved {hours}-hour policy. Late cancellation charges apply to the booking total, including equipment, HST and the service fee. For early cancellation after confirmation, the actual card processing fee is kept. Open the booking to review your policy and exact refund before cancelling.
bookingChefChanges: Open the booking to request cancellation. For a date/time change, contact {contact}. Your confirmed dates remain in place until a change is agreed.
bookingStaffChanges: Open the booking to review its current status and cancellation requests. Coordinate a date/time change with the booking contact and Local Cooks.
bookingCancelledBody: This kitchen booking has been cancelled. Open your bookings to review the recorded outcome or choose another visit.
bookingSettingsBody: Review the changes below before your next visit. Open the kitchen for its current settings.
bookingAccessRequestBody: {chef} requested access to {kitchen}. Review the application and respond. This request does not reserve kitchen time.
bookingAccessApprovedBody: You can now request available kitchen time. Kitchen access does not reserve a visit; each booking is confirmed separately.
bookingNotificationChangedBody: This address will receive updates for {kitchen}. If you didn’t make this change, contact Local Cooks.
bookingStorageRequestBody: {chef} requested more time for {storage}. Review the new end date and approve or decline the extension.
bookingStoragePaymentBody: Your payment is recorded. The kitchen still needs to approve the extension; keep your current removal date until it is accepted.
bookingStorageApprovedBody: Your extension is approved. Plan removal by the new end date and coordinate with the kitchen.
bookingStorageDeclinedBody: Your extension was declined. Your current removal date remains in place. Open the booking to review the decision and any refund.
bookingOverstayBody: Your storage period has ended. Contact the kitchen to confirm removal or request an extension. Any amount shown is an estimate until a charge is recorded.
bookingPenaltyChargedBody: The storage overstay payment is recorded. Open your storage booking to review the charge and arrange removal if needed.
bookingManagerOverstayBody: Coordinate removal of {storage} with {chef}. Review the current storage record before deciding the next step.
bookingLicenseApprovedBody: Your kitchen licence is approved. Open the kitchen to review availability and listing details.
bookingLicenseRejectedBody: Review the feedback and upload a corrected kitchen licence. Local Cooks will review the new document.
bookingLicenseSubmittedBody: A kitchen licence was submitted. Open the kitchen to review the document and record a decision.
bookingLicenseExpiryBody: Your kitchen licence expires on {expiry}. Upload the renewed licence to keep new bookings available.
bookingManagerMixedBody: Arrival method varies by visit. Plan who will welcome {chef} and open each visit for its arrival details.
bookingManagerLegacyBody: Plan who will welcome {chef}. Review the arrival arrangements and kitchen contact on the booking page.
bookingStorageCheckoutBody: {chef} requested checkout for {storage}. Inspect the storage and confirm physical removal before approving clearance.
bookingStorageClaimBody: The kitchen filed a claim after inspecting your storage. Review the claim and respond from your dashboard. A claim does not prove a charge or physical removal.
bookingRequestPendingBody: {kitchen} received your request. Your kitchen time is not confirmed. Open your request for the current payment status and next steps.
bookingRequestPaidBody: Your payment is recorded, and {kitchen} still needs to accept the request. Open the request for its current status and next steps.
bookingNewRequestPendingBody: Review this request and respond to the customer. The booking is not confirmed; open it for the current payment status.
bookingClaimChargedBody: Your claim payment is recorded. Open the claim to review the outcome and payment record.
bookingFeedbackReminder: How was your session at {kitchen}? It takes 30 seconds.
bookingFeedbackFlagBody: Someone shared a concern about their session. Open the booking to read their private feedback and see how we can help.
payoutReleasedBody: You’ve been paid {amount} for {chef}’s booking on {date}. It’s on its way to your bank.
payoutReleasedNext: Stripe sends it to your bank on your usual payout schedule. You’ll see the arrival date in your Stripe dashboard.
managerCheckoutReviewBody: {chef} checked out. Review the kitchen by {date}.
payoutHeldBody: Your payout for {reference} is on hold while Local Cooks reviews the reported issue. We’ll let you know when it’s released.
managerCheckoutPayoutTitle: {chef} checked out — finish the inspection to get paid
managerCheckoutPayoutBody: {chef} checked out. Finish the inspection to get your {amount} now, or it's sent automatically on {date}.
bookingManagerPayoutAfterCloseout: Paid after the visit — as soon as you finish the inspection, or automatically 24 hours after it ends.
managerRunningLateBody: {chef} is running about {duration} late. Their booking still ends at {end}.
managerNoCheckinBody: {chef} hasn’t checked in yet. Their booking started at {start}.
sxRequestedBody: {chef} asked for {duration} at {kitchen} (until {end}) · you’d get {payout}. Open the booking to approve or decline. The request closes at {expires}, and their card is only charged if you approve.
sxConfirmedChefBody: Your extra time at {kitchen} is confirmed. You have until {end}. {amount} was charged to your card.
sxOfferAcceptedManagerBody: {chef} accepted your offer of {duration}. Their booking now ends at {end} · you’d get {payout}.
sxDeclinedChefBody: {kitchen} couldn’t extend this time. Your card wasn’t charged. Your booking still ends at {originalEnd}.
sxRequestExpiredManagerBody: {chef}’s request for {duration} closed before it was approved. Their card wasn’t charged and their booking still ends at {originalEnd}.
sxOfferedChefBody: {kitchen} offered you {duration} (until {end}) · {amount}. Accept and pay on your booking page before {expires}. Extra time can’t be refunded once it’s added.
sxOfferDeclinedManagerBody: {chef} said no thanks to {duration}. Their booking still ends at {originalEnd}.
sxOfferExpiredManagerBody: Your offer of {duration} to {chef} closed without an answer. Their booking still ends at {originalEnd}.
sxExtraTimeChefBody: You stayed {stayed} past your booking at {kitchen}. They’ve asked for {amount} for {billed} of extra time. Open your booking to pay, or tell us if it isn’t right. Nothing is charged until you choose.
sxPaidChefBody: You paid {amount} for {billed} of extra time at {kitchen}. Thank you!
sxWithdrawnChefBody: {kitchen} withdrew the {amount} extra-time charge. You don’t owe anything for the extra time.
sxUpheldChefTitle: Local Cooks reviewed the extra-time charge: {amount} is due
sxUpheldChefBody: Local Cooks reviewed your concern about the extra-time charge from {kitchen} and decided {amount} is due. Pay by {payBy} on your booking so you can keep making new bookings.
sxUpheldManagerTitle: Local Cooks decided {amount} is due for extra time
sxUpheldManagerBody: Local Cooks reviewed {chef}’s concern and decided {amount} is due for the extra time. {chef} has until {payBy} to pay; you’ll be told when it’s paid.
sxWaivedChefTitle: Local Cooks waived the extra-time charge
sxWaivedChefBody: Local Cooks reviewed your concern and waived the extra-time charge from {kitchen}. You don’t owe anything for the extra time.
sxWaivedManagerTitle: Local Cooks waived the extra-time charge
sxWaivedManagerBody: Local Cooks reviewed {chef}’s concern and waived the extra-time charge. Nothing will be charged for this visit’s extra time.
sxPaidManagerBody: {chef} paid {amount} for {billed} of extra time · you’d get {payout}. It’s paid out with this booking.
sxDisputedChefBody: Thanks for telling us. Local Cooks will review the extra-time charge from {kitchen} and get back to you. Nothing was charged.
sxDisputedManagerBody: {chef} said the extra-time charge of {amount} isn’t right. Local Cooks will look into it and contact you both. Nothing was charged.
sxSupportDisputedBody: {chef} questioned the extra-time charge of {amount} from {kitchen} for {billed}. No card was charged; please follow up with both of them.
sxEscalatedChefBody: {kitchen} asked for {amount} for {billed} of extra time. We haven’t heard from you in 48 hours, so Local Cooks will follow up. You can still pay or tell us it isn’t right on your booking page. Nothing has been charged.
sxEscalatedManagerTitle: Local Cooks is following up with {chef}
sxEscalatedManagerBody: {chef} hasn’t answered your extra-time charge of {amount} in 48 hours. Local Cooks will follow up with them. Nothing has been charged.
sxSupportUnansweredBody: {chef} hasn’t answered the extra-time charge of {amount} from {kitchen} for {billed} in 48 hours. No card was charged; please follow up.
sxCardFailedChefBody: Your saved card was declined for {amount} of extra time at {kitchen}. Nothing was charged. Choose “Pay with another card” from your booking, or message {kitchen}.
sxGrantedEndChefBody: {kitchen} gave you {duration} at no charge. You have until {end}.
sxGrantedStartChefBody: {kitchen} let you start {early} early, at {end} — no charge. You can check in from then; your booking still ends at the same time.
sxEarlyOfferedChefBody: {kitchen} can let you start {early} early, at {end} · {amount}. Accept and pay on your booking page before {expires}. Extra time can’t be refunded once it’s added.
sxEarlyConfirmedChefBody: Your earlier start at {kitchen} is confirmed: {end}. {amount} was charged to your card. You can check in from then.
sxEarlyDeclinedManagerBody: {chef} said no thanks to starting at {end}. Their booking still starts at {originalEnd}.
sxEarlyExpiredManagerBody: Your offer for {chef} to start at {end} closed without an answer. Their booking still starts at {originalEnd}.
sxGrantedRequestChefTitle: {kitchen} gave you until {end} at no charge
sxGrantedRequestChefBody: {kitchen} approved your request at no charge. You have until {end}, and the hold on your card was released.
ncConfirmedPayout: Paid after the visit — as soon as you finish the inspection, or automatically 24 hours after it ends.
ncSessionEndingBody: Your booked time at {kitchen} ends at {time} ({zone}). {count, plural, =0 {Open your visit to check out.} one {Complete 1 departure task, then check out from your visit page.} other {Complete # departure tasks, then check out from your visit page.}}
ncVisitCompleteInvoice: Your receipts are on the booking. Your final statement will be ready once everything is settled.
ncCancelledRefundTitle: Booking cancelled · {amount} refund on its way
ncCancelledNoRefundTitle: Your booking is cancelled · no refund applies
ncDurationHoursMinutes: {hours, plural, one {1 hr} other {# hrs}} {minutes} min
bookingNotIncludedChef: {items} — the kitchen couldn’t provide it, so you weren’t charged for it.
bookingNotIncludedStaff: {items} — declined at approval; the customer wasn’t charged for it.
sxRefundedChefBody: We couldn’t add the time at {kitchen}. You were refunded {amount}. Your booking time has not changed.
sxRequestExpiredChefBody: {kitchen} didn’t answer your request for {duration} in time, so it closed. Your card wasn’t charged. Your booking still ends at {originalEnd}.
bcHoldLine: {amount} is on hold on your card.
bcMoneyRefund: a {amount} refund is on its way (banks usually show it within 5–10 business days)
bcReleasedLine: Your card hold of {amount} was released.
bcRequestedManagerBody: {chef} asked to move {reference} from {old} to {new}. Your payout would change by {amount}. Answer by {deadline}. Their refund deadline would move to {freeCancel}.
bcRequestedChefBody: Change request sent to {kitchen} · they have until {deadline} to answer. {hold}
bcDeclinedChefBody: {kitchen} couldn’t move your booking · it stays {old}. {released} {message}
bcDeclinedManagerBody: You declined {chef}’s request to move {reference} · it stays {old}.
bcExpiredChefBody: {kitchen} didn’t answer your change request in time, so your booking stays {old}. Your card wasn’t charged.
bcExpiredManagerBody: You didn’t answer {chef}’s request to move {reference} in time · it stays {old}.
bcWithdrawnManagerBody: {chef} withdrew the request to move {reference} · it stays {old}.
bcWithdrawnChefBody: You withdrew your change request · your booking stays {old}. {released}
bcClosedChefBody: Your change request was closed because the booking was cancelled. {released}
bcClosedManagerBody: {chef}’s request to move {reference} was closed because the booking was cancelled.
bcCardDeclinedChefBody: Your saved card was declined, so your change request wasn’t sent to {kitchen}. Pay with another card to send it. Your booking stays {old}.
bcRecoveryChefBody: We couldn’t finish your booking change, so your booking stays {old}. Local Cooks is checking the payment and will sort out anything owed.
bcRecoveryManagerBody: The change to {chef}’s booking {reference} couldn’t be finished, so it stays {old}. Local Cooks is checking the payment.
bcUnsentExpiredChefBody: Your change request for {kitchen} expired before it was sent. Your booking stays {old}. Your card wasn’t charged.
bcRefundKeptChefBody: The change at {kitchen} didn’t go through. Your booking stays {old}. The refund of {amount} stands.
bcRefundKeptManagerBody: {chef}’s change didn’t go through. The booking stays {old}. Your payout is unchanged by this.
bcRefundKeptAdminTitle: Booking change closed with refund kept · {reference}
bcRefundKeptAdminBody: {chef}’s change at {kitchen} from {old} to {new} didn’t go through. The booking stays {old}. The refund of {amount} stands and is funded by Local Cooks. The kitchen payout is unchanged by this recovery.
bcRefundIfApprovedLine: If they approve, you’ll get {amount} back.
bcRequestedManagerSameBody: {chef} asked to move {reference} from {old} to {new}. Same price, so your payout doesn’t change. Answer by {deadline}. Their refund deadline would move to {freeCancel}.
tourFeedbackRequestedCompletedBody: Tell us how your kitchen tour at {kitchen} went and what we could do better. It takes a minute.
tourFeedbackManagerCompletedBody: Tell us how the tour with {visitor} at {kitchen} went. It takes a minute.
tourVisitCompletedChefBody: Thanks for touring {kitchen}. When you’re ready to book it, request to apply.
tourVisitCompletedKitchenBody: {visitor} came to the tour of {kitchen}. They can request to apply, or you can add them as a customer.
tourVisitAbsentChefBody: {kitchen} reported that you didn’t come to your tour. If that’s wrong, contact Support. You can request a new tour from the kitchen page.
tourVisitAbsentKitchenBody: You reported that {visitor} didn’t come to the tour of {kitchen}.
tourVisitUnknownChefBody: Your tour of {kitchen} has ended. Request to apply when you’re ready to cook here.
tourVisitUnknownKitchenBody: The tour time with {visitor} at {kitchen} has passed. You can add them as a customer from the tour.
